items.title: Nvidia to Pay $290 Million to Settle Long-Running Crypto Mining Revenue Lawsuit
items.summary: The proposed cash settlement would resolve a shareholder suit alleging the chipmaker hid how much of its 2017-2018 gaming revenue came from crypto miners.

items.title: French Senate blocks new crypto tax and wallet list critics called a kidnapping risk
Elon Musk’s X Wins Court Judgment Against Alleged Bitcoin Bot Farm Operators
items.summary: London’s High Court entered a default judgment against Vivek Kumar Sen and Zamyang Sherpa after they failed to respond, though damages, which X estimates at over £207,000, won’t be set until a later hearing.
